newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-Greenalls heads for 12 pct growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Greenalls heads for 12 pct growth.

text.p: Pub-to-hotels group Greenalls Group Plc is expected to report a 12 percent upturn in its half-year profits on Monday, helped especially by its Premier Inns and wholesaling business, analysts said.

Brokers forecasts for pretax profits range from 61.1 million stg to 66 million, up from 57 million last time, although three of the six brokers polled said they thought the risks to their forecasts were on the upside. A dividend of 6.7p per share is expected, up from 6.22p.

Greenall's wholesaling business, the largest in the country with annual turnover of 200 million stg and 45 depots supplying restaurants and free trade pubs, is expected to benefit from better margins.
Earnings from its city centre pubs and pub-restaurants are also likely to be higher, said analysts.

"On the hotel side, de Vere at the top end and Premier Lodge at the bottom are both doing well. Premier, benefited from Granada's decision to increase its prices at Travel Lodge," said one analyst who chose not to be named.

Greenalls gave an update on trading in February covering the first four months of the current financial year. The company said food and drink sales in its managed pubs were up 5.9 percent, while gaming machine revenue per outlet rose 17.9 percent over the same period last year.

The shares were 8-1/2p lower on Friday at 493p compared with a year high of 588p. Analysts said the shares have come under pressure since the stock fell out of the FTSE 100 and index-tracking fund managers sought to sell. -- Tim Farrand, +44 171 542 6437
